case.summary: Investigation of alert HHG-009 confirmed card-not-present fraud on card C08299-K1 following a direct customer dispute. Customer C08299 reported transaction 3581141 ($30.02) as unauthorized, which had an elevated model score of 0.984 and no baseline history in billing region 203. Subsequent account activity revealed two additional unauthorized online purchases on 2016-12-30 totaling $40.09 with high model scores. The activity is classified as card_not_present_fraud with a 0.94 probability and total exposure of $70.11. Card C08299-K1 has been blocked to stop further compromise.
